text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, Machikane Tannhauser 
seems like an ordinary Umamusume you could 
find anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her friends knew her as someone 
who possessed the strength to face head-on 
the very things that would intimidate an 
"ordinary" Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she wasn't aware of it herself... 
Chairwoman Akikawa pointed out, "That's 
your greatest charm!"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by such expectations, Machikane 
Tannhauser is suddenly pumped full of 
energy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so began the days of striving for 
victory together with this "ordinary," 
hardworking, and slightly clumsy girl.
